featured_reviews.name: Mihir Nagda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a really great experience at Circle Tattoo! My friend and I went in for matching minimal tattoos on our forearms, and everything from start to finish was handled so smoothly. The studio felt clean and professional, and it was reassuring to see that all the equipment used was brand new and properly sealed.

The artist was extremely sweet-spoken, patient, and made sure we were comfortable the entire time. Even though it was a small, minimal design, they paid close attention to detail and placement, which really shows in the final result. The whole process took less than 20 minutes, but it never felt rushed.

We absolutely loved how our tattoos turned out—clean, precise, and exactly what we wanted. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for minimal or fine line tattoos done professionally!

name: Al's Alva's Tattoo & Piercing Studio - Best tattoo studio in Mumbai
description: A proud member of the Mumbai tattoo artist community, Al's Alva's Tattoo & Piercing Studio provides exceptional tattoo artistry in a welcoming, hygienic setting. We specialize in custom tattoos, traditional tattoos, realistic tattoos, 3D photo-real tattoos, mandala and geometric designs, abstract tattoos, sleeve tattoos, cover-ups, fine line work, black and grey realism, and memorial tattoos. We also offer professional body piercings — ear, nose, navel, eyebrow, industrial, septum — plus permanent makeup, microblading, and tattoo removal. With a reputation for creativity, attention to detail, and client satisfaction, we are Bandra West's go-to destination for quality tattoos and piercings.

featured_reviews.name: Paras Bhatia
featured_reviews.review_text: Walked in for a consult on a piercing that’s refusing to heal. The owner got the diagnosis in a second and suggested appropriate ways to heal the piercing. Although I didn’t get the piercing from them they were kind enough to give guidance. Good chap, would get the other ear poked here after the current one heals.

featured_reviews.name: Mohini Asolkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I walked in for a shoot-related requirement which, by the way, they didn’t even have. While I was there, I casually asked this guy (owner or whatever title he’s clinging to) if they still do ear piercings, because I had an old one that closed. That’s it. A simple question.
Before I could even process what was happening, this man had the audacity to grab my ear and force an earring through it no consent, no warning, nothing. Just straight-up invasive and unprofessional behavior. I didn’t ask for that. I didn’t need that. But clearly, basic boundaries aren’t his thing.
I kept it cool, said thanks, and was ready to leave because I actually have a life and work to get back to. But he just wouldn’t stop. Kept shoving earrings in my face like I owed him a purchase for something I never even asked him to do. I politely refused multiple times.
Then comes the best part: his ego couldn’t handle it. The second I mentioned wanting something more reasonable (just to get out of there), he flipped. Started repeating the same dumb line “if you can’t take it, don’t think about it” like he’d just discovered his one and only personality trait.
The shop was full, and he still chose to embarrass himself publicly. Loud, insecure, desperate for validation it was honestly hard to watch. I stayed calm the entire time, because unlike him, I don’t need to prove anything to strangers to feel important.
What’s truly ironic is that the one thing I actually went there for they didn’t even have. Zero product, zero professionalism, and yet a full-blown superiority complex.
I genuinely don’t know how people tolerate someone this pushy, this rude, and this completely lacking in basic sense. But hey, I guess when you have nothing substantial to offer, attitude becomes the only thing you can sell.

featured_reviews.name: Smruti Jagdale
featured_reviews.review_text:
My tattoo artist Harsh was so sweet and friendly. He is a true professional as he listened to my preferences and suggested his thoughts too.

A great experience for my first tattoo! Arun was really polite, helpful and friendly when I had called him the day before as well as when I visited the place. You might feel that it's a bit expensive but it's totally worth it!

featured_reviews.name: Mogh Guralwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
al's alva's tattoo and body piercing is located on hill road, bandra.
the place itself houses various intriguing items. you can find almost anything in their store.
the staff was friendly enough to help me around and explore their store.
they specialise in tattoos and piercings. got my ear piercing done. thanks to AJ, the experience was seamless and painless. their ear studs collection had variety aswell.
a much recommended place for your next piercings!

featured_reviews.name: Snehal Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience at Al's Tattoos have always been good I've got four of my tattoo here. Arun the owner of the shop is always friendly and helpful with everything. I have got all my four tattoos by their Tattoo Artist Harsh, he's very helpful while customising a tattoo designs and always consider my preferences while making the tattoos.

featured_reviews.name: Pradnya Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text: Never knew that a worst tattoo of my life would cost me around 3.5k. I did my tattoo with Al's in January 2025 as it was my birthday month and they actually made sure that this mistake of mine should be so worst that i should regret it for my whole life. Now you will say why am I posting this now as it's become almost an year, so let me tell you this that after my tattoo didn't turn up the way I want they ask me to visit them in the month of February and when I visited them they told me to wait for 40 day as the wound needs healing. I was like ok, but after 40 days when I was doing the follow up with them they just ignored me saying that the phone number for Al's tattoo is different and get in touch with them not us. All falls promises and nothing else. Don't waste your money here as they won't help if anything goes wrong.

featured_reviews.name: Yash Setpal
featured_reviews.review_text: Mr. Arun was very hospitable and explained the entire process along with the aftercare of the tattoo brilliantly. Mr. Harsh, the man with the skilled hand was super patient, precise in his work , and understood the requirement perfectly! Great job done, would 10/10 recommend and will visit again surely!

featured_reviews.name: Bhuvika Guglani
featured_reviews.review_text: I live in Punjab and couldn’t go to this place in Mumbai. But i had a helix piercing in Feb 2025 from a local place and it was causing swelling and infection which wasnt going away even after 9 months. So i reached out to  AJ in Nov 2025 and guess what he replied back!! I showed him the issue and he instantly gave me the solution to it. I was also having doubts about 2-3 things and everytime i texted him, he replied. Such a sweet person. I have been following his advice for 2 days only and will share the results. But thankyou so muchhh❤️ YOU’RE THE BEST. I already knew there’s no one better who i can consult for such an issue.
